waybackify audit [flags] <dir>

Checkpointed wayback-404 audit of a ledger

Audit every capture the ledger under <dir> references — a checkpointed,
resumable wayback-404 sweep. Captures are discovered via generic ledger
discovery (the same corpus-agnostic frontier `cache fill` uses), then
each UNIQUE capture is run through the verdict engine and its result
appended to a JSONL checkpoint. Re-running skips checkpointed captures,
so an interrupted run (archive.org throttling, ^C) resumes.

Slow, network-heavy, human-supervised: it refuses to run under CI.
Output: progress on stderr, a verdict summary on stdout.

Arguments:
  <dir>                 root to discover wayback.json manifests under

Flags:
  --checkpoint <file>   JSONL checkpoint file (resume/skip) — default <dir>/.audit/checkpoint.jsonl
  --limit <n>           audit only the FIRST n unique captures, sorted by capture key
  --delay-ms <n>        pause between captures (default 500)
  --timeout <n>         per-request timeout in ms (default 60000)
  --report <file>       also write the summary as JSON
  --help|-h             Show help

part of the wayback mirror tooling
